answer: Edge-Centrality Credit Cap. Each agent's transaction weight is capped by its betweenness centrality in the live interaction graph, so a new node starts on a narrow ledge of influence until real neighbors route flow through it. A sybil cluster must graft its vertex onto high-traffic paths, paying bandwidth and latency to relay genuine volume, and each forged lotus of fake peers stays isolated with near-zero routing share, so duplicates add cost without added reach.
